about: Exceptions for scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs. A secret-rule entry only lets through values that look fake (fixture markers, a few distinct characters, a PEM body of a few bytes); a real key in the same file is still reported. Each entry needs a reason.

entries.reason: Service-account fixture whose PEM body is 4 characters, so it cannot be a key.
Scanner tests feed fake secrets and fake client data to the scanner; secret rules still require the value to look fake.
